# dokploy_environment (Resource)

Manages an environment within a Dokploy project. Environments allow you to organize and isolate applications and databases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dokploy_project" "myproject" {
  name = "My Application"
}

resource "dokploy_environment" "production" {
  name        = "Production"
  description = "Production environment"
  project_id  = dokploy_project.myproject.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import dokploy_environment.production "project-id-123:environment-id-123"
```
